The '''Kardava system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Sevastol sector/Legends|Sevastol sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the group known as [[Kardavan penitents]], whose membership included individuals of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GAR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kardava system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
